audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Enemy coalition, named ancient peoples, conspiracy, violent imprecation, land, and divine-name petition.

verses.restored: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

familiar.text: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

notes.title: Enemy coalition
notes.body: The named peoples belong to ancient poetic geography. They must never be mapped onto modern Jews, Palestinians, Arabs, Muslims, Christians, nations, ethnicities, or political opponents.

modern.text: O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

original.text: שִׁ֖יר מִזְמ֣וֹר לְאָסָֽף אֱלֹהִ֥ים אַל דֳּמִי לָ֑ךְ אַל תֶּחֱרַ֖שׁ וְאַל תִּשְׁקֹ֣ט אֵֽל

verses.restored: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

familiar.text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

modern.text: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.

original.text: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֣ה א֭וֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָי֑וּן וּ֝מְשַׂנְאֶ֗יךָ נָ֣שְׂאוּ רֹֽאשׁ

verses.restored: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

familiar.text: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

modern.text: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,

original.text: עַֽל עַ֭מְּךָ יַעֲרִ֣ימוּ ס֑וֹד וְ֝יִתְיָעֲצ֗וּ עַל צְפוּנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

familiar.text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

modern.text: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”

original.text: אָמְר֗וּ לְ֭כוּ וְנַכְחִידֵ֣ם מִגּ֑וֹי וְלֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֖ר שֵֽׁם יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עֽוֹד

verses.restored: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

familiar.text: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

modern.text: For with one mind they plot together, they form an alliance against You—

original.text: כִּ֤י נוֹעֲצ֣וּ לֵ֣ב יַחְדָּ֑ו עָ֝לֶ֗יךָ בְּרִ֣ית יִכְרֹֽתוּ

verses.restored: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

familiar.text: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

modern.text: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

verses.restored: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

familiar.text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

modern.text: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.

original.text: גְּבָ֣ל וְ֭עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק פְּ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת עִם יֹ֥שְׁבֵי צֽוֹר

verses.restored: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

familiar.text: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

modern.text: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah

original.text: גַּם אַ֭שּׁוּר נִלְוָ֣ה עִמָּ֑ם הָ֤י֥וּ זְר֖וֹעַ לִבְנֵי ל֣וֹט סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: Do to them as to the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

familiar.text: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

modern.text: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,

original.text: עֲשֵֽׂה לָהֶ֥ם כְּמִדְיָ֑ן כְּֽסִֽיסְרָ֥א כְ֝יָבִ֗ין בְּנַ֣חַל קִישֽׁוֹן

verses.restored: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

familiar.text: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

modern.text: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.

original.text: נִשְׁמְד֥וּ בְֽעֵין דֹּ֑אר הָ֥יוּ דֹּ֝֗מֶן לָאֲדָמָֽה

verses.restored: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

familiar.text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

modern.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

original.text: שִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ נְ֭דִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵ֣ב וְכִזְאֵ֑ב וּֽכְזֶ֥בַח וּ֝כְצַלְמֻנָּ֗ע כָּל נְסִיכֵֽמוֹ

verses.restored: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

familiar.text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

modern.text: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָ֭מְרוּ נִ֣ירֲשָׁה לָּ֑נוּ אֵ֝֗ת נְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

familiar.text: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

modern.text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

original.text: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י שִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ כַגַּלְגַּ֑ל כְּ֝קַ֗שׁ לִפְנֵי רֽוּחַ

verses.restored: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

familiar.text: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

modern.text: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

original.text: כְּאֵ֥שׁ תִּבְעַר יָ֑עַר וּ֝כְלֶהָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט הָרִֽים

verses.restored: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

familiar.text: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

modern.text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.

verses.restored: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O YHWH.

familiar.text: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

modern.text: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.

original.text: מַלֵּ֣א פְנֵיהֶ֣ם קָל֑וֹן וִֽיבַקְשׁ֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

familiar.text: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

modern.text: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.

original.text: יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲל֥וּ עֲדֵי עַ֗ד וְֽיַחְפְּר֥וּ וְיֹאבֵֽדוּ

verses.restored: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is YHWH, art the most high over all the earth.

familiar.text: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.

modern.text: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.

original.text: וְֽיֵדְע֗וּ כִּֽי אַתָּ֬ה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה לְבַדֶּ֑ךָ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: This psalm carries extreme modern reception risk. Ancient names must never be mapped onto living ethnic, national, religious, or political groups, and its curses cannot authorize violence.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
